Flips cluster at HIGH-ENTROPY STRUCTURAL BOUNDARIES (codefence ```, prose Let, tool-call, JSON brace) because those have small clean margins (1-2nat) the ~2.5-max_abs residual can cross; format-fixed positions have huge margins and do NOT flip (oracle dev=0).
RECONCILING the per-layer ~ULP floor with carrier-reopen's 'dev up to 10, NOT sub-ULP': NOT a contradiction — it is the compounding. ~1 ULP at L0 (0.0078) compounds geometrically ~1.17x/layer to final_norm max_abs ~2.5 / L2 ~103 (MEASURED), and pushed through the lm-head GEMV that is a ~10-nat logit swing on one token (the ``` collapse was ~10.7nat). So the floor (~1 ULP, sub-noise) and the boundary flip (dev~10, structural) are the SAME phenomenon at two depths: ~1ULP(L0) → ~2.5/103(L63) → ~10nat(post-lm-head), beating a 0.5-1.9nat margin. The floor claim is NOT revised, it is reconciled by ×14,800 compounding + the GEMV.
~16 cat9 vs 3 native = TOPOLOGY multiplier (MEASURED de-cascade FR13_CARRIER_REOPEN): native ONE linear spine FLASH_ATTN = 3 ([0,0,2,1]); cat9 9-node caterpillar with TWO extra divergent kernels + more forwards = ~13-15 genuine in-topk near-tie crossings of the SAME boundaries native crosses, PLUS ~5 fork-progeny (p3 ctrl-basin = 1 root fork at pos95 + 5 downstream) → raw 23, de-cascaded ~14-18.
